why.title: Why WebP?
why.p1: WebP is a modern image format developed by Google.
list: SEO Boost: Faster sites rank better on Google.
Mobile Friendly: Uses less data for mobile visitors.
Support: Supported by Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and all modern browsers.

faq.title: Vanliga frågor
faq.a1: Yes, our PNG to WebP converter is completely free to use.
faq.a2: No. Unlike JPG, WebP supports transparency (alpha channel). Our converter preserves your transparent background.
faq.q3: How much space will I save?
faq.a3: WebP images are typically 26% smaller than PNGs. In many cases, you can see reductions of up to 50% without noticeable quality loss.
faq.a4: WebP is now supported by all major modern browsers, including Google Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari (on macOS 11+ and iOS 14+).
faq.a5: Yes. All conversion processing is done in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to our servers.
